title: CHEEKY LEASH
tickerText:
DEBUT ALBUM -  HOW MUCH LOVE HAVE I GOT LEFT - OUT NOW

Cheeky Leash are a four-piece from Wollongong making big, sun-soaked rock songs with plenty of hooks and zero interest in keeping things small. Somewhere between coastal indie, massive choruses and the kind of songs that make a lot more sense with a beer in your hand and a crowd around you.

Chris Mott, Jayden Cano, Brad Heffernan and Brody Blackman have built a solid live reputation along the way, including a main stage spot at Yours and Owls. Their debut album How Much Love Have I Got Left landed in 2026, with plenty more noise to come.

NOTHING BUT MONKEY BUSINESS
